representation_fit.evidence: Brief demands many high-hierarchy high-density entities managed by batch ops; impl renders a 3-level region→system→device tree (source/data.js:4-24, 138 devices in screenshots/1280x860.png) plus a flat table with an explicit 归属路径 column (source/app.js:174) — hierarchy in the sidebar, density in the table, ownership in every row.

primary_task_salience.evidence: Initial screen is dominated by batch affordances: checkbox column on every tree node and table row, 全选可见 button, 已选 0 项 counter, per-row 状态 dropdowns, 操作记录 0 button (screenshots/1280x860.png; source/index.html:19,45,52; batch action bar pre-built at index.html:60-76, revealed on selection per app.js:192-210).

time_to_understand.evidence: Title 'TreeLedger · 设备资产批量管理台' + cell tag, column labels, tree nodes with counts ('4 系统 · 55台'), and header stats legend with status counts make what/where immediately legible in both screenshots/1280x860.png and screenshots/1440x900.png; source/index.html:6,15-16,24.

navigation_cost.evidence: Zero steps to primary object: table lists all devices flat at load (显示 138 条, screenshots/1440x900.png); tree roots pre-expanded (app.js:69) with 全展开/全折叠 (index.html:25-26); search, status filter, and one-click subtree scope chip (app.js:148-160, 213-219) shorten reach further.

context_loss.evidence: All primary actions are in-place: fixed batch bar (styles.css:138-142), enumerated-confirm modal, toast+undo (app.js:290-298), op-log drawer, subtree scope chip with clear button; no href/location navigation exists anywhere in source (app.js:386-466 is entirely event-driven on one page).

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent surfaces limited to topbar, tree pane, toolbar, table — all job-required for high-density batch management; heavy surfaces are conditional: batchbar hidden at 0 selection (index.html:60, app.js:194), drawer off-canvas (styles.css:159-165), modal only on confirm (app.js:301-302).

accessibility.evidence: Receipt fails 4 checks: a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size (measurement-summary.json:13-16). Source corroborates: --faint #94a0b5 text on white for tree meta/cell-tag (styles.css:5,49,89), 14px checkboxes and 16px tree toggles (styles.css:79,87), 2px-padding 12px status selects (styles.css:127), no :focus-visible styles anywhere, tree rows are click-only divs (app.js:387-397); only partial mitigation is native form controls and one aria-label (app.js:123).

frontend_rework.evidence: No visible layout defects and 3/7 receipt checks pass — layout.overflow, layout.responsive_collision, text.truncation (measurement-summary.json:10-12), both viewports render cleanly. But 4 failing a11y/type checks (measurement-summary.json:13-16) imply concrete remediation rework across contrast tokens, target sizes, focus management, and 11-12px type scale (styles.css:37-38,49,87,120-127).

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '批量选择与操作零误伤，状态归属显式' is addressed in depth: three-state subtree checkboxes (app.js:89-96), selection split of devices vs org nodes with '节点本身不改动' note (app.js:202-204), confirm modal enumerating every affected device grouped by system with old→new status and guard '未列出的 N 台不受任何影响' (app.js:329-337,357), 全选可见 restricted to filtered rows (app.js:417-422), per-op [id,from,to] change log with undo (app.js:269-287), explicit per-row status + 归属路径 + CSV 区域/系统/状态 columns (app.js:165-174,371-376).

defects_observed: a11y.contrast=fail (measurement-summary.json); low-contrast --faint #94a0b5 on white used for tree meta, cell tag, tn-meta (styles.css:5,49,89) and gray 停用 pill visible in screenshots/1440x900.png
a11y.target_size=fail (measurement-summary.json); 14px checkboxes (styles.css:87), 16x16px tree toggle buttons (styles.css:79), 12px status selects with 2px padding (styles.css:127)
a11y.focus_order=fail (measurement-summary.json); no :focus-visible styling in styles.css, tree rows and name-click scope are click-only div/span handlers (app.js:387-397)
type.min_projected_size=fail (measurement-summary.json); pervasive 10-12px type for meta, codes, paths, pills (styles.css:37,38,49,89,120-127)
Hidden affordance: clicking a tree node name sets the table scope with no initial-screen hint beyond cursor:pointer (app.js:129,396; styles.css:88)
missing_evidence: Sanitized receipt gives only pass/fail per check id — no element-level detail for which contrast pairs, targets, or focus-order positions failed
Operated states (batch bar, confirm modal, undo toast, op-log drawer) are verifiable only in source code and source/driver.js scenarios; provided screenshots show only the initial 0-selected state
scores.overall_note: Impl-17 is a structurally excellent fit for the manage × entity-hierarchy cell: the initial screen (both screenshots/1280x860.png and screenshots/1440x900.png) pairs a counts-annotated hierarchy tree with a flat 138-row table carrying explicit 归属路径 and per-row status controls, so batch selection and operation are the dominant, zero-navigation task. The acceptance seed is covered unusually thoroughly — three-state subtree selection, device-vs-org-node accounting, enumerated confirm modals with an explicit 'unlisted devices unaffected' guard, filtered-scope select-all, and a per-device undoable change log (app.js:89-96, 202-204, 329-337, 417-422, 269-287). The clear weakness is accessibility: the sanitized receipt fails 4 of 7 checks (a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size; measurement-summary.json:13-16), and the source corroborates each with low-contrast faint text tokens, 14-16px targets, no focus-visible handling, and a 10-12px small-type scale — implying remediation rework even though layout checks pass and no visual defects appear in either viewport. Task time, retrieval accuracy, and human preference remain not observable in this blind pilot; the accessibility score reflects model-judged receipt plus source structure, not human testing.
